description: Canonical JSON and signed envelope vectors, shared by knowtarium/crypto (signs) and knowtarium/protocol (verifies on the server). The signed message is the UTF-8 bytes of "knowtarium-envelope-v1\n" followed by the canonical JSON of the fields; signatures are Ed25519, base64url; keys and messages are lowercase hex. Every signedEnvelopes entry uses ids, keys and times knowtarium/protocol accepts; every invalidEnvelopes entry must be refused by both. types lists, per envelope type, the fields it requires besides baseFields, the optional ones (signed when present) and the optional groups that come all or none. nonCanonicalJsonText holds values with no canonical form as JSON text, to be parsed first. recipientsHashes pins recipientsHash: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 recipientsHashTag followed by the X25519 public keys, deduplicated, sorted by their bytes, each prefixed by its length as a uint32 big-endian, as lowercase hex. keyCommitments pins workspaceKeyCommitment: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 keyCommitmentTag, the generation as a uint32 big-endian, the 32-byte key and the UTF-8 workspace id, as lowercase hex. agentPolicyHashes pins agentPolicySha256: each folder override's sha256 is SHA-256 of the UTF-8 agentPolicyFolderTag followed by the canonical JSON of {folderId, mode}; text is agentPolicyTag followed by the canonical JSON of {default, folders: the overrides' sha256 values, sorted}; policySha256 is SHA-256 of text, as lowercase hex. The agent_edited vector is signed by the agent's own key (its own signingSeed), the key the agent_key vector vouches for, and names the agent_policy vector's revision and policySha256.
